# Real AI-generated images used as test fixtures

| File | What it is | Source | Licence | Changed? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini_c2pa.jpg` | Banner generated by Google Gemini, carrying Google's signed C2PA manifest ("Created by Google Generative AI", IPTC `trainedAlgorithmicMedia`, SynthID applied) | [michaelblaess/c2pa-scanner](https://github.com/michaelblaess/c2pa-scanner/blob/1dd4d0a686b7fbf772717b8665027fb9c2aa4149/docs/banner.jpg) | Apache-2.0 | No. Byte-for-byte, so the signature still validates |
| `sd_parameters.png` | Stable Diffusion landscape (forest with Shinto shrine) by Benlisquare | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Algorithmically-generated_landscape_artwork_of_forest_with_Shinto_shrine.png) | Public domain | Scaled from 4096 to 512 px wide; its original `parameters` text chunk (prompt and settings) copied over unchanged |
| `ai_stripped_elf.png` | "Cyborg elf, science fantasy", generated with Stable Diffusion; published with no generator metadata | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cyborg_elf,_science_fantasy,_Stable_Diffusion_AI_art.png) | CC0 | Scaled from 1024 to 512 px wide |
| `ai_stripped_android.png` | "Android making a conclusion in 2740", AI-generated by Prototyperspective; no generator metadata | [Wikimedia Commons](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Android_making_a_conclusion_in_2740.png) | CC0 | Scaled from 2048 to 512 px wide |

The two "stripped" images are the hard, common case: an AI image whose
metadata is gone. Metadata layers must find nothing in them; only the
optional classifier can say anything, and only as a likelihood.
